sourceText: Utterson ruminated a while; he was surprised at his friend’s selfishness, and yet relieved by it. “Well,” said he, at last, “let me see the letter.”

TRANSLATION: jan Utason li toki insa lon tenpo lili. ona li kama sona e ni la, ona li pilin nasa: jan pona ona li lukin taso e ona sama. taso ni li weka e pilin ike tan jan Utason. tenpo pini la, ona li toki e ni: “pona. o pana e lipu tawa mi. mi wile lukin e ona.”
